title: Our Taiwan Adventure
intro: In 2026 our family spent two weeks exploring Taiwan. Scroll down to follow along, one stop at a time!

blocks.caption: Raohe Street Night Market lit up after dark

blocks.text:
We went to the Raohe Night Market, one of the most popular night markets in Taipei. It's one long street packed with food stalls and games, and it gets busy as soon as the sun goes down.

At the entrance is a colourful temple, and right next to it is a famous stall that bakes pepper buns in a clay oven.
